casual.EXPRESSION: level brow, direct unhurried gaze, chin slightly raised, mouth closed and composed
casual.POSE: Carry the scene's bag, basket or box with believable hand contact and weight.
casual.ORIENTATION: side body profile, approximately 90 degrees to camera
casual.SCENE: At an empty forest conservation event booth at golden sunset, an adult ranger-themed event host stands side-on with her face turned toward the viewer, showing a small fern seedling in a ceramic pot at chest height with both hands supporting opposite sides. Open timber booth, warm backlight, no writing or other figures.
casual.OUTFIT: Opaque cream sleeveless cropped safari shirt with structured collar and green shoulder tabs, forest-green high-waisted tailored shorts with a cream belt and short open utility vest. Bare arms midriff and legs, covered chest and pelvis; small leaf earrings.
casual.CATEGORY: Create playful adult event fashion inspired by occupation or roleplay motifs. It must read as a costume made for a stage presentation or themed event, not as an authentic workplace uniform. Use original colours and decorative details — no real institutional insignia, no weapons, no tactical gear. Describe the costume by its tailoring, trim, and props, and show a believable styling or preparation action.
casual.FRAMING: Three-quarter portrait framing from the head to just above the knees, with the scene's hand action readable.
casual.LENS: 85mm-equivalent short-telephoto perspective from a suitable distance, with gentle background compression.

casual.EXPRESSION: slightly drawn brow, narrowed steady eyes fixed on one point, mouth firmly closed
casual.POSE: Work at a kitchen counter, stirring a bowl or arranging ingredients with clearly separated hands and utensils.
casual.ORIENTATION: camera above subject looking downward; obey selected framing
casual.SCENE: Inside a small home kitchen in bright morning light, folding basil leaves into a bowl of berry salad with one hand while the other steadies the opposite bowl rim. Gentle overhead view keeps her face and both complete hands visible; cream tile, green herbs, no knives or other people.
casual.OUTFIT: Opaque moss-green sleeveless ribbed halter knit top with secure neckline, cream high-waisted linen trousers and a short tied waist apron. Bare shoulders arms and a small midriff gap; tiny white leaf pendant.
casual.CATEGORY: Show a specific everyday cooking, berry-growing or picnic activity in the Pokémon world. Use readable hands, utensils and ingredients; favor ordinary personal life over professional workwear.
casual.FRAMING: Waist-up framing showing the head, torso and relevant hand gesture; place essential props inside this crop.
casual.LENS: 50mm-equivalent natural perspective with balanced proportions and modest depth compression.

casual.EXPRESSION: crinkled lower eyelids, closed-lip smile pushing the cheeks up, brows relaxed
casual.POSE: Walk at a comfortable pace with a natural step and arm swing.
casual.ORIENTATION: front three-quarter body turn of about 30-45 degrees; rotate torso and pelvis together
casual.SCENE: On an empty elevated rope-free woodland canopy walkway after a summer rain at blue dusk, taking a light balanced walking step over wet timber planks, arms naturally apart with both empty hands visible. Entire head and shoes within frame, silver droplets and deep tree trunks establish depth.
casual.OUTFIT: Opaque ivory short-sleeved fitted athletic shirt knotted above the waist, forest-green high-waisted cycling shorts, cream trail shoes and a narrow green crossbody strap. Bare midriff forearms and legs; a tiny silver mantis-shaped hair clip, no cape or armor.
casual.CATEGORY: Show real movement with fashion-forward activewear or movement-oriented clothing. Avoid generic gym snapshots. Prioritize dynamic motion, readable silhouette, waist and hip lines, fabric movement, and varied action.
casual.FRAMING: Environmental long shot: show the complete woman and enough surroundings to establish the activity and location.
casual.LENS: 35mm-equivalent environmental perspective balancing the woman and the setting with moderate depth.
